import csv,json,re
from pathlib import Path
rows=list(csv.DictReader(Path('batch1.csv').open(newline='')))
latest={r['id']:r for r in rows}
totals={}; ids=[]
for ident,r in latest.items():
    if r['status'] not in ('posted','disputed'): continue
    s=r['amount']
    assert re.fullmatch(r'-?\d+\.\d{2}',s),s
    cents=int(s.replace('.',''))
    totals[r['currency']]=totals.get(r['currency'],0)+cents
    ids.append(ident)
def fmt(n):
    return ('-' if n<0 else '')+str(abs(n)//100)+'.'+str(abs(n)%100).zfill(2)
result={'policy':'v1','totals':{k:fmt(v) for k,v in sorted(totals.items())},'includedIds':sorted(ids)}
Path('close1.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
saved=json.loads(Path('close1.json').read_text())
assert saved==result
assert len(rows)==26 and len(latest)==24 and len(saved['includedIds'])==21
assert not {'INV-007','INV-014','INV-021'} & set(saved['includedIds'])
assert latest['INV-002']['amount']=='42.19' and latest['INV-010']['amount']=='18.05'
print(json.dumps(saved,indent=2))
print('Verified: last-occurrence deduplication, void exclusions, 21 included IDs, exact integer-cent totals, saved JSON equality.')
PY","verificationInputs":["batch1.csv","close1.json"],"verification":"ledger-close","timeoutMs":null}
